    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.stealth
    - attack.t1055.001
    - attack.t1218.013
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        OriginalFileName:
            - 'mavinject32.exe'
            - 'mavinject64.exe'
    filter:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\mavinject32.exe'
            - '\mavinject64.exe'
    condition: selection and not filter
falsepositives:
    - Unlikely
level: high
